```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

# Reading csv file
I selected the E. coli dataset from the UKHSA website. I have read the data into csv files and made the first ten lines into a table.
```{r}
e_coli <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

gt(head(e_coli))
```

Next, I will visualize this data into a plot using ggplot.
```{r}
ggplot(e_coli, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value,
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") + 
  ylab("Cases") +
  ggtitle("Lead poisoning cases by Date")
```
